data.title: 常陆茉子 · 夜雨压上纸门
data.description: 一阵风把廊下的风铃吹到了门框上。茉子穿着系好的象牙色长睡袍出门，双手将木窗推回原位，直到门栓扣响才松开。
data.location: 旧屋内廊与面对庭院的木窗
data.action: 用双手推合木窗，腰带将长睡袍系紧
data.lighting: 室内纸灯映在门槛，庭院的雨是冷蓝色
data.camera: 从内廊平视的背侧全身
data.promptProse: Mako slides the wooden shutter closed from the inside hallway. An ivory ankle-length robe wraps over her and closes with a cotton sash, its broad sleeves hanging as she grips the frame. The warm paper lamp touches the threshold while the rain outside stays blue.
data.animaCaption: Both wide sleeves lift as she guides the shutter home; the cotton sash keeps the robe closed.
